title: A varint is written in the shortest encoding of its value
description: 300 as a bddo:varuint is LEB128 AC 02; -3 as a bddo:varint is zigzag 5, one byte 05; 300 as a bddo:sqliteVarint is 82 2C. Each is the shortest encoding: no padding continuation byte is written, whatever length a stream the tree was parsed from gave it.
